title: HVAC and Plumbing in San Antonio, TX
desc: Rosenberg Plumbing and Air offers services for HVAC and plumbing in San Antonio, TX and the surrounding areas. Call today for fast service!

blocks.text: At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air, we offer reliable HVAC and plumbing services throughout San Antonio, TX. We make sure your home stays comfortable no matter the season. With over three decades of experience, our certified technicians and plumbers are equipped to handle everything from air conditioner installations to plumbing repairs. We prioritize clear communication and affordable solutions that fit your needs. Whether you’re dealing with a sudden drain issue or preparing for seasonal HVAC maintenance, we can help keep your heating, cooling, and plumbing systems in top shape.
San Antonio’s Most Trusted HVAC Professionals

San Antonio’s summers push cooling systems hard, and many homes run AC units nearly nonstop for months at a time. That kind of use makes breakdowns more common due to weak airflow, refrigerant leaks, or compressors that simply wear out. Our technicians repair and replace equipment when problems surface, but we also keep systems on track with routine maintenance. Through our Comfort Club Membership, we perform a cooling tune-up before summer and a heating tune-up before winter. Members receive repair discounts, lower service fees, and priority scheduling, which helps when service demand is high.

Families with multiple systems often choose our Enhanced Maintenance Plan, which adds a free drain line clearing and lifetime thermostat coverage. When a new installation is the better choice, financing is available with approved credit, making large projects easier to manage. As an A+ rated business with the BBB, we’re committed to bringing the highest level of service to San Antonio homes every day.
Dependable Plumbing Service Across San Antonio

Water issues are a daily concern in Texas homes. Our plumbers handle repair and replacement for leaks, drains, and water heaters, but we also give homeowners the option of a structured maintenance plan. Our Plumbing Maintenance Program includes a yearly water heater flush, inspections of key plumbing lines and fixtures, a pressure test, toilet leak checks, and a water hardness test. These visits give us a clear picture of how the system is holding up and allow members to save on plumbing repairs throughout the year.

For larger jobs, flexible financing helps spread out costs without delaying necessary work. With more than 10,000 customer reviews, national industry awards, and consistent local recognition, we’ve built a reputation for plumbing service that San Antonio residents can count on.
Our team offers reliable heating, cooling, and plumbing assistance on demand. When you need a reputable HVAC and plumbing contractor in San Antonio, give Rosenberg Plumbing & Air a call!
